---
title: "RFC 011: Ingestion Watcher Phase"
subtitle: "Scan, Poll, and Watchfiles Integration"
date: 2026-01-19
---

## Executive Summary

This phase implements watcher integration from RFC 008 by adding scan and polling helpers plus a `watchfiles`-backed watcher with a polling fallback. The watcher utilities provide ready‑file detection without a full daemon, ensuring testability and deterministic behavior.

## Implementation Scope

| Area | Deliverable | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Scan helpers | `list_ingestion_files`, `scan_ready_files` | Separate ready vs pending files. |
| Polling | `poll_ready_files` | Loop with configurable max cycles. |
| Watcher | `watch_ready_files` | Uses watchfiles when available, falls back to polling. |

: Table 1. Watcher phase deliverables.

## Code Changes

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/autoclean/utils/ingestion.py` | Added scan, poll, and watch utilities. |
| `tests/unit/utils/test_ingestion.py` | Added scan/poll/watch fallback tests. |
| `pyproject.toml` | Added `watchfiles` dependency. |

: Table 2. Code updates delivered.

## Test Results

```bash
uv run --with pytest --with pytest-cov python -m pytest \
  tests/unit/utils/test_ingestion.py --cov-fail-under=0
```

Result: 10 tests passed. Coverage threshold was overridden (`--cov-fail-under=0`) due to repository defaults. Pytest emitted an unknown `timeout` config warning; uv reported a link‑mode fallback warning when installing the updated dependency set.

## Follow‑Up Work

1. Extend watcher to emit structured events into serve dispatch.
2. Add integration tests for watchfiles event handling.

## Appendix A: Behaviors

- Ready files are detected per‑file using sentinels; pending items remain until signals are present.
- Watchfiles is optional; polling fallback preserves deterministic behavior in constrained environments.
